command:
source "$HOME/build-workers/worker-env.sh" || exit $?
pnpm fixtures || exit $?
unset IFCLITE_SMLIB_WORKER
printf 'Exact/default full workspace and region foundation; SDK-gated tests disabled and not qualified in this run.\n'
cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast
workspace_status=$?
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
clippy_status=$?
printf 'workspace_exit=%s clippy_exit=%s\n' "$workspace_status" "$clippy_status"
if [ "$workspace_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$workspace_status"; fi
exit "$clippy_status"
scope: Full Rust exact/default workspace and region foundation, strict all-target Clippy; SDK-gated earlyreturns explicitly excluded, not native/browser/Python/performance qualification
